book_verdict: Main text is broadly followed but with frequent misreadings; p.117 imports two dozen line-ends of the facing page as 'margin', and p.347 garbles the astrological symbols and turns 'diliget te' into 'diligenter', losing what the recipe is for.

other.note: <meta> block describing pencil marks and facing-page text sits in the transcription; a reader would see it if the tag is not hidden

book_verdict: The best of the four readings: the text is right nearly throughout, including 'de rasuris', 'diliget te' and the symbols. The slips are 'composui' for 'componi' and the doubtful 'duorum … sanguine' on p.347.
